examples: The magic trick will amaze you.

more.def: To fill someone with great surprise or wonder.
examples: The size of the whale amazed everyone on the boat.
It amazes me how many stars you can see in the desert.
The young chess player amazed the crowd with her skill.

more.def: So surprising or wonderful that it is hard to believe.
examples: The view from the mountain top was amazing.
It is amazing how fast a cheetah can run.

easy.def: In the middle of a group.
examples: The cat was among the toys.

more.def: In the middle of or surrounded by a group of things.
examples: The cat hid among the boxes.
She sat among her friends at lunch.
A small cottage stood among the trees.
